policy: Edit our original district paintings; established original courtyard is style reference only. No Cuphead raster inputs. Preserve accepted geography; assess style through visual review, not automated test pass.

district1.first: Use case: style-transfer, substantial environment repaint. IMAGE1 is the ORIGINAL MAP EDIT TARGET; preserve its exact geography, perspective, image bounds, building silhouettes and front-door positions, coast/pond edges, roads, stairs, bridges and traversable clearings. IMAGE2 is ONLY a painting-language/value/atmosphere reference from our own shipped game courtyard; never transfer its architecture, side-view composition, dragon carving, flags or perspective. Match its hand-inked, softly brush-painted theatrical stage scenery, pooled watercolor/gouache washes and controlled atmospheric depth. The current map is overdecorated polished miniature illustration; a slight desaturation or softening is NOT enough. REPAINT with broad grouped masses and loose expressive ink; remove at least70percent of tiny pots/flowers/individual cobbles/window trim/pipe fittings/white glints. Keep only simplified quiet masses in the same collision footprints. Matte materials, subdued metal and glass with only one or two muted tonal shapes, no metallic gold gleam. Cool smoky teal/celadon and dusty plum-gray scenery, warmstone/cream walking paths, limited quiet ochre accents. Clearly readable footplanes; high-frequency texture and detail should not blanket floors/water. Peripheral landscape fades into low-contrast haze; near frame uses sparse darker ink, middleground buildings quieter than future crisp saturated characters. Same light direction, broad few-value grouping instead of smoothly modeled 3D volume, irregular human brushwork and subtle paper. Do not add film damage, yellow sepia filter, blur, bright orange wash, shiny toy surfaces or photoreal shading. This is original Bubble Brigade game art inspired by broader theatrical cel principles, not copying another game's assets. NO characters, UI, text, icons, new props or relocated scenery. Square image, same exact crop and layout. Architectural simplification may remove ornament but MUST preserve main silhouette, footprint and doorway geometry. Specific edit: Bubblebrook Quay harbor. Keep the crescent quays, winding canal, two crossings, southern domed lighthouse, shell post office, sailcloth workshop, pearl pump station and tug clubhouse exactly placed. Transform current polished golden-glass domes into softly inked subdued teal glass/aged brass simple painted forms without moving silhouette. Simplify shrubs to broad dark celadon/plum shapes, erase individual flower confetti and most cobble outlines. Distant cliff islets softer/lower contrast; sea broad smoky teal washes with sparse irregular ripples. Warm pale paths stay visibly walkable, all doors maintain their same teal shape/location. The final should sit naturally beside the original courtyard reference as one game's painted world, with strong bright-actor-over-quiet-world hierarchy.
district1.second: Use case: style-transfer. Image1 is the original harbor MAP TARGET, image2 our established courtyard painting STYLE reference only. This is SECOND correction because first repaint remained a dense polished miniature with a blue color grade. Need actual repaint and shape simplification, NOT more global tint. LOCK exact map composition and footprint geometry, front doors, bridge/coast/road/stairs, square crop. MATERIAL RENDERING CHANGES: (1) ERASE the individual tiny cobblestones everywhere; paint continuous pale warm stone washes with only a handful of broad broken paving seams/scuffs per clearing. (2) Domes/glass become 2–3 broad matte teal wash masses, NO point glints, shiny ball gradients or many circular reflections. Preserve dome silhouette/doors. (3) Broad pooled water washes with sparse gestural ripple strokes; remove allover dappled mosaic texture. (4) Foliage into unbroken smoky green/plum silhouettes with perhaps3painted leaf clumps per bush, NO individual leaves/pots/confetti. (5) Architecture walls/roofs are 2–3 broad handpainted color planes; aged unpolished brass becomes subdued umber, no golden rims. (6) Selective ink and depth: key near doors/ground edges retain irregular thin charcoal contours; farther northern islets/background banks lose edges into lighter cooler fog, visibly softer than southern playfield. Do NOT uniformly outline every post/roof tile/window/stone. Group secondary rail posts into quiet rhythm; retain physical placement. Keep distinct muted LOCAL MATERIAL colors cream stone, smoky teal sea/glass, dusty terracotta sailcloth, subdued green vegetation: NOT a blue filter overeverything. Same camera, same source geometry. Brushy watercolor/gouache stage painting onpaper, visible irregular edge pooling, broad composition valuegroups. No vector-flat childrenbook, no 3D toy render, no photorealism, no digitalairbrush gradients, no blurfilter, no addedobjects/characters/UI/text. Original Bubble Brigade art only. Image2 supplies the broad wash/irregular ink/atmospheric softening that should be visibly present, not its castle architecture or scene composition.
district1.finishing: Precise environment painting edit. IMAGE1 is our original harbor painting to finish. IMAGE2 is our original game's courtyard, reference ONLY for broad wash/atmospheric edge loss. Preserve exact image1 camera, all doors/roofs/building silhouettes, shore edges, road/bridge/stair footprints and square bounds. Preserve the improved matte architecture, muted local colors, simple foliage and broad stone path treatment. Change ONLY TWO things: 1 WATER: remove its allover small dappled/mosaic surface texture. Repaint the water as LARGE calm pooled smoky-teal watercolor masses, with a few broad translucent horizontal brush strokes. Leave most water interiors quiet and open, barely textured paper. Sparse broken ripples at shore/boat contacts only. NO repeated wave squiggles across every water patch, NO faceted polygon mosaic, NO scratchy grain everywhere. Keep water a quieter support behind the walkable shore. 2 FAR EDGE LOSS: along the uppermost quarter of image, gently lighten/cool distant islets, northern trees and rear bank contours into atmospheric haze, lose select contour segments in mist. Keep actual door thresholds and paths clear; don't move or hide landmarks. Keep southern foreground ink darker so near/middle/far hierarchy is visible. This is selective painted atmospheric layering, NOT a global blur/filter or desaturation. All geometry must remain pixel-aligned, no extra objects/characters/UI/text. Loose watercolor/gouache stage-paint marks and thin irregular ink, not glossy 3D miniature or clean vector art.

district2: Use case: style-transfer, substantive original map repaint. IMAGE1 is the map EDIT TARGET: lock exact geography, building silhouettes and front-door positions, all coast/pond/terrain edges, paths, bridges, stairs, camera, square crop. IMAGE2 is the corrected ORIGINAL HARBOR STYLE MASTER, not a layout template. IMAGE3 is our ORIGINAL COURTYARD reference for wash/ink/value hierarchy only; never copy its architecture/perspective. Repaint image1 in this same game's subdued theatrical watercolor/gouache stage language. Actual simplification, NOT a color filter: remove70–80percent of tiny pot/flower/windowtrim/pipe/cobble decorations; replace dense ground marks with continuous quiet washes and only a handful of irregular broken seams; broad grouped foliage silhouettes, no flower confetti or individually outlined leaves. Architecture and roofs use 2–3 matte hand-painted tonal planes, sparse thin irregular ink at key edges/doors, no polished 3D airbrush modeling. Glass/metal subdued and matte, no clusters of specular glints, no golden rimshine. Open water/sky calm broad pooled washes with sparse local ripples only, no allover dappled mosaic surface. Selective cool haze and edge loss on northern/far scenery, clearer midground doorsteps, sparse darker near framing. Preserve distinct muted LOCAL COLORS of each district, no global blue/sepia wash. Saturated dark-ink dragon actors will be composited later; world must remain quieter, but traversable floor vs water/sky/obstacles stays clear. Subtle paper pooling and visible human brush irregularity, not every surface covered in grain. No blur filter, vector-flat sticker style, photoreal shading, miniature toy gloss, new objects/characters/UI/text. Original Brigade artwork, no Cuphead assets or compositions. Specific target Fernfall Gardens: keep seedling school, root library, flower conservatory, butterfly greenhouse and acorn mill in EXACT same positions and silhouettes. Preserve the entire irregular pond/river/bridge topology and every stair/path width. Material palette muted celadon/olive/smoky greens, dusty plum-pink conservatory petals, warm neutral pale stone; NO bright pink/yellow flower confetti. Group outer forest into broad atmospheric masses; northern treetops and waterfall cliffs recede softly. Glass greenhouse broad pale dusty teal planes with almost no glints; brass aged brown. Simplify foreground garden beds without changing their obstacle footprint. Ground large quiet stone washes, pond quiet pooled blue-green with few shore ripples. Keep the landmarks whimsical but simplify their surface drawing so the future cel dragon remains the focus.
